data.name: Hollowcross
data.detailed_description:
Bind the risen. Hold back the Hollowing.

The dead do not rest at the crossroad. Gather a collection of cursed souls, master the five strains of the Cross, and prove yourself across four complete ways to play — from lightning auto-battles to real-time castle sieges. One collection. Four games. Endless dark.

Hollowcross is a gothic-horror collectible card game where every card you own plays in every mode — so the deity you forge in one becomes a weapon in all of them.

Four games, one cursed collection

⚔️ Battler — Walk the Saga

Bind a warband of five and let them fight. Battles auto-resolve in a cinematic clash you can watch in 2D or 3D. March through the Warden's Saga — a sprawling story campaign of rising foes and dark truths — then test your warband against other Wardens on the Ranked ladder.

🎲 Gauntlet — Break the House

A roguelike draft. Pull cards from a shifting shop, merge duplicates into starred powerhouses, and out-survive an eight-warband lobby. Climb the purgatorial death-casino known as The House — all the way to its grinning croupier god.

👻 Souls — Duel of the Damned

Take the field yourself in a turn-based 1v1 of summons, strikes, and blocks. Spend your souls, hold the line with guardians, heal, hex, and pierce — and climb 26 tiers of the Gallows Spire to face the gentleman-ghost who waits at the summit.

🏰 Siege — Storm the Keeps

Real-time, three-lane castle warfare. Spend gold to deploy your host, push down the lanes, and raze the enemy keep before they raze yours. Guardians raise shields, mages hurl fireballs, hexers slow the advance — and whole castles get up and walk.

Master the Cross

Five strains devour one another — SPIRIT ▸ FLESH ▸ BLOOD ▸ STORM ▸ VOID ▸ SPIRIT. Strike into a strain you beat and hit 50% harder. Every card also carries a battlefield role — Guardian, Mender, Hexer, Mage, or Bruiser — so who you field matters as much as what.

Collect. Forge. Ascend.

  • 1,700+ cards across six rarities, from Common to the mighty Deity.
  • Fuse and evolve — feed duplicates to level your cards and evolve them into higher stars.
  • Earn the deities — complete each mode's story to claim its unique god card. They can't be bought or dropped — only earned.
  • Every mode levels on its own — its own progression, climb, and story — while your cards, shop, upgrades, and guild are shared across all four.

Play your way

  • Free to play.
  • 2D or 3D — swap the battlefield renderer any time.
  • Cross-platform — play on Steam or in your browser; your Warden follows you.
  • Guilds & community — found a guild, wear a tag, and climb together.
  • 64 achievements to hunt across the four modes.

The crossroad is open, Warden. What will you bind?

data.short_description: The Hollowing spreads, Warden. Hollowcross is live and free to play right now — bind a warband, walk the Saga, and test your soul across all four modes. 🎴 1,700+ cards · ⚔️ Battler · 🎲 Gauntlet · 👻 Souls · 🏰 Siege · Join the ritual on Discord.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64‑bit)
  • Processor: Dual‑core 2.0 GHz (Intel Core i3 / AMD equivalent)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Any WebGL 2.0 / DirectX 11 capable GPU (Intel HD 4000+)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 700 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: Persistent broadband required — online multiplayer. Free account required. Card art streams and caches on first view.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 (64‑bit)
  • Processor: Quad‑core 2.5 GHz+
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU or modern integrated
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: Persistent broadband required — online multiplayer. Free account required. Card art streams and caches on first view.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11 Big Sur
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i3
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal‑capable (integrated fine)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 700 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: Universal build — runs native on Apple Silicon & Intel.
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 13 Ventura or later
  • Processor: Apple M1/M2 or Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple GPU / dedicated
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: Universal build — runs native on Apple Silicon & Intel.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 / SteamOS 3 (glibc 2.31+)
  • Processor: Dual‑core 2.0 GHz (64‑bit)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.3 / WebGL 2.0 (Mesa)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 700 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: Runs great on Steam Deck (SteamOS).
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 / SteamOS 3+
  • Processor: Dual‑core 2.0 GHz (64‑bit)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Vulkan‑capable GPU
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: Runs great on Steam Deck (SteamOS).
